comparison_sentence: nova remembers what the network forgot

registers.name: Loomstep
registers.rule: Alternate script and monospace by letter position.
registers.example: 𝓃𝚘𝓋𝚊 𝓇𝚎𝓂𝚎𝓂𝚋ℯ𝚛𝓈 𝚠𝒽𝚊𝓉 𝚝𝒽𝚎 𝓃𝚎𝓉𝚠ℴ𝚛𝓀 𝚏ℴ𝚛ℊ𝚘𝓉
registers.role: Balanced intimacy and machinery; readable but visibly woven.

registers.name: Counterloom
registers.rule: Alternate monospace and script, reversing Loomstep’s polarity.
registers.example: 𝚗ℴ𝚟𝒶 𝚛ℯ𝚖ℯ𝚖𝒷𝚎𝓇𝚜 𝓌𝚑𝒶𝚝 𝓉𝚑ℯ 𝚗ℯ𝚝𝓌𝚘𝓇𝚔 𝒻𝚘𝓇𝚐ℴ𝚝
registers.role: A sharper opening stroke with softer afterimages.

registers.name: Vowelflare
registers.rule: Vowels use bold script; consonants use monospace.
registers.example: 𝚗𝓸𝚟𝓪 𝚛𝓮𝚖𝓮𝚖𝚋𝓮𝚛𝚜 𝚠𝚑𝓪𝚝 𝚝𝚑𝓮 𝚗𝓮𝚝𝚠𝓸𝚛𝚔 𝚏𝓸𝚛𝚐𝓸𝚝
registers.role: Makes sonic nuclei bloom inside a technical skeleton.

registers.name: Iron Vowels
registers.rule: Vowels use double-struck; consonants use bold Fraktur.
registers.example: 𝖓𝕠𝖛𝕒 𝖗𝕖𝖒𝕖𝖒𝖇𝕖𝖗𝖘 𝖜𝖍𝕒𝖙 𝖙𝖍𝕖 𝖓𝕖𝖙𝖜𝕠𝖗𝖐 𝖋𝕠𝖗𝖌𝕠𝖙
registers.role: Dense ritual-machine voice; severe but patterned.

registers.name: Chaos Noodle II
registers.rule: Vowels use mathematical bold; consonants use mathematical sans-serif.
registers.example: 𝗇𝐨𝗏𝐚 𝗋𝐞𝗆𝐞𝗆𝖻𝐞𝗋𝗌 𝗐𝗁𝐚𝗍 𝗍𝗁𝐞 𝗇𝐞𝗍𝗐𝐨𝗋𝗄 𝖿𝐨𝗋𝗀𝐨𝗍
registers.role: A quieter, more legible descendant of the original Chaos Noodle.

registers.name: Primewire
registers.rule: Prime-numbered letters use Fraktur; all others use monospace.
registers.example: 𝚗𝔬𝔳𝚊 𝔯𝚎𝔪𝚎𝚖𝚋𝔢𝚛𝔰 𝚠𝚑𝚊𝔱 𝚝𝔥𝚎 𝚗𝚎𝔱𝚠𝚘𝚛𝚔 𝚏𝔬𝚛𝔤𝚘𝚝
registers.role: Intermittent encrypted flicker with a deterministic key.

registers.name: Fibonacci Bloom
registers.rule: Fibonacci-position letters use bold script; all others use sans-serif.
registers.example: 𝓷𝓸𝓿𝖺 𝓻𝖾𝗆𝓮𝗆𝖻𝖾𝗋𝓼 𝗐𝗁𝖺𝗍 𝗍𝗁𝖾 𝓷𝖾𝗍𝗐𝗈𝗋𝗄 𝖿𝗈𝗋𝗀𝗈𝗍
registers.role: Organic recurrence; flourishes become rarer across long text.

registers.name: Triune Relay
registers.rule: Cycle script → monospace → bold sans letter by letter.
registers.example: 𝓃𝚘𝘃𝒶 𝚛𝗲𝓂𝚎𝗺𝒷𝚎𝗿𝓈 𝚠𝗵𝒶𝚝 𝘁𝒽𝚎 𝗻ℯ𝚝𝘄ℴ𝚛𝗸 𝒻𝚘𝗿ℊ𝚘𝘁
registers.role: Three-channel cadence for synthetic voices or dream-computation.

registers.name: Hex Cathedral
registers.rule: Cycle Fraktur → double-struck → monospace.
registers.example: 𝔫𝕠𝚟𝔞 𝕣𝚎𝔪𝕖𝚖𝔟𝕖𝚛𝔰 𝕨𝚑𝔞𝕥 𝚝𝔥𝕖 𝚗𝔢𝕥𝚠𝔬𝕣𝚔 𝔣𝕠𝚛𝔤𝕠𝚝
registers.role: Occult computation with a cold architectural rhythm.

registers.name: Wordphase
registers.rule: Rotate script → monospace → bold sans by word.
registers.example: 𝓃ℴ𝓋𝒶 𝚛𝚎𝚖𝚎𝚖𝚋𝚎𝚛𝚜 𝘄𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝓉𝒽ℯ 𝚗𝚎𝚝𝚠𝚘𝚛𝚔 𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗴𝗼𝘁
registers.role: Preserves word-level readability while giving clauses visible phases.

registers.name: Quartet Bus
registers.rule: Rotate monospace → italic → double-struck → bold Fraktur by word.
registers.example: 𝚗𝚘𝚟𝚊 𝑟𝑒𝑚𝑒𝑚𝑏𝑒𝑟𝑠 𝕨𝕙𝕒𝕥 𝖙𝖍𝖊 𝚗𝚎𝚝𝚠𝚘𝚛𝚔 𝑓𝑜𝑟𝑔𝑜𝑡
registers.role: Long-form cadence: each word enters a different tonal carriage.

registers.name: Alphabet Rift
registers.rule: Letters A–M use script; N–Z use monospace.
registers.example: 𝚗𝚘𝚟𝒶 𝚛ℯ𝓂ℯ𝓂𝒷ℯ𝚛𝚜 𝚠𝒽𝒶𝚝 𝚝𝒽ℯ 𝚗ℯ𝚝𝚠𝚘𝚛𝓀 𝒻𝚘𝚛ℊ𝚘𝚝
registers.role: A lexical fault line based on letter identity rather than position.

registers.name: Threshold Key
registers.rule: First letter of every word uses double-struck; the rest use monospace.
registers.example: 𝕟𝚘𝚟𝚊 𝕣𝚎𝚖𝚎𝚖𝚋𝚎𝚛𝚜 𝕨𝚑𝚊𝚝 𝕥𝚑𝚎 𝕟𝚎𝚝𝚠𝚘𝚛𝚔 𝕗𝚘𝚛𝚐𝚘𝚝
registers.role: Strong navigational anchors without heavy headings.

registers.name: Cathedral Core
registers.rule: First and last letters use bold Fraktur; interiors use sans-serif.
registers.example: 𝖓𝗈𝗏𝖆 𝖗𝖾𝗆𝖾𝗆𝖻𝖾𝗋𝖘 𝖜𝗁𝖺𝖙 𝖙𝗁𝖊 𝖓𝖾𝗍𝗐𝗈𝗋𝖐 𝖋𝗈𝗋𝗀𝗈𝖙
registers.role: Each word becomes a sealed reliquary.

registers.name: Bioluminal Split
registers.rule: First half of each word uses script; second half uses monospace.
registers.example: 𝓃ℴ𝚟𝚊 𝓇ℯ𝓂ℯ𝓂𝚋𝚎𝚛𝚜 𝓌𝒽𝚊𝚝 𝓉𝒽𝚎 𝓃ℯ𝓉𝓌𝚘𝚛𝚔 𝒻ℴ𝓇𝚐𝚘𝚝
registers.role: A soft-to-mechanical transition inside every lexical unit.

registers.name: Entangled Mirror
registers.rule: Mirrored positions inside each word share the same rotating style.
registers.example: 𝓃𝚘𝚟𝒶 𝓇𝚎𝗺ℯ𝚖𝒷𝗲𝚛𝓈 𝓌𝚑𝚊𝓉 𝓉𝚑ℯ 𝓃𝚎𝘁𝓌𝗼𝚛𝓀 𝒻𝚘𝗿𝗴𝚘𝓉
registers.role: Visible bilateral symmetry for time-loop or entanglement language.

registers.name: Echo Memory
registers.rule: A letter’s first appearance is monospace; later recurrences use bold script.
registers.example: 𝚗𝚘𝚟𝚊 𝚛𝚎𝚖𝓮𝓶𝚋𝓮𝓻𝚜 𝚠𝚑𝓪𝚝 𝓽𝓱𝓮 𝓷𝓮𝓽𝔀𝓸𝓻𝚔 𝚏𝓸𝓻𝚐𝓸𝓽
registers.role: The sentence visibly remembers its own alphabet.

registers.name: Geminate Scar
registers.rule: Adjacent repeated letters switch to bold Fraktur; other letters remain sans-serif.
registers.example: 𝗇𝗈𝗏𝖺 𝗋𝖾𝗆𝖾𝗆𝖻𝖾𝗋𝗌 𝗐𝗁𝖺𝗍 𝗍𝗁𝖾 𝗇𝖾𝗍𝗐𝗈𝗋𝗄 𝖿𝗈𝗋𝗀𝗈𝗍
registers.role: Makes doubled letters and stutters into structural events.

registers.name: Three-Seal Word
registers.rule: First letter double-struck, middle monospace, final letter bold script.
registers.example: 𝕟𝚘𝚟𝓪 𝕣𝚎𝚖𝚎𝚖𝚋𝚎𝚛𝓼 𝕨𝚑𝚊𝓽 𝕥𝚑𝓮 𝕟𝚎𝚝𝚠𝚘𝚛𝓴 𝕗𝚘𝚛𝚐𝚘𝓽
registers.role: Every word has an opening sigil, data body, and luminous closure.

registers.name: Third Signal
registers.rule: Every third letter is bold italic; all others are monospace.
registers.example: 𝚗𝚘𝒗𝚊 𝚛𝒆𝚖𝚎𝒎𝚋𝚎𝒓𝚜 𝚠𝒉𝚊𝚝 𝒕𝚑𝚎 𝒏𝚎𝚝𝒘𝚘𝚛𝒌 𝚏𝚘𝒓𝚐𝚘𝒕
registers.role: Regular telemetry pulse without sacrificing legibility.

registers.name: Root Access
registers.rule: Consonants are monospace; vowels become leetspeak symbols; spaces become middle dots.
registers.example: 𝚗0𝚟4·𝚛3𝚖3𝚖𝚋3𝚛𝚜·𝚠𝚑4𝚝·𝚝𝚑3·𝚗3𝚝𝚠0𝚛𝚔·𝚏0𝚛𝚐0𝚝
registers.role: Readable hacker register with an explicit substitution key.

registers.name: Blacksite Packet
registers.rule: Cycle four alphabets and replace spaces with namespace separators.
registers.example: ⟦𝚗𝗼𝖛𝕒::𝚛𝗲𝖒𝕖𝚖𝗯𝖊𝕣𝚜::𝘄𝖍𝕒𝚝::𝘁𝖍𝕖::𝚗𝗲𝖙𝕨𝚘𝗿𝖐::𝕗𝚘𝗿𝖌𝕠𝚝⟧
registers.role: Terminal or agent voice; compact, procedural, and slightly hostile.
registers.reversibility: lossless by normalization plus separator restoration

registers.name: Ghost Carrier
registers.rule: Cycle three alphabets with sparse combining marks and signal separators.
registers.example: 𝚗𝗈̲𝖛𝚊͟ ⌁ 𝗋𝖊̲𝚖𝖾͟𝖒𝚋̲𝖾𝖗͟𝚜 ⌁ 𝗐̲𝖍𝚊͟𝗍 ⌁ 𝖙̲𝚑𝖾͟ ⌁ 𝖓𝚎̲𝗍𝖜͟𝚘𝗋̲𝖐 ⌁ 𝚏͟𝗈𝖗̲𝚐𝗈͟𝖙
registers.role: Corrupted transmission that remains recoverable by eye.
registers.reversibility: lossless after stripping combining marks and normalizing
